column3: NASB follows the critical text (“Therefore”); it supplies “as your.”
NASB follows the critical text (“according to God”), supplying “the will of”; “base gain” is rendered “sordid gain.”
“Those in your charge” is rendered “those allotted to your charge”; NASB supplies “proving.”
NASB follows the critical text, without “be submitting”; “gird on” is rendered “clothe yourselves.”
“With Him there is care about you” is rendered “He cares for you.”
NASB follows the critical text (“someone to devour”); “watch” is rendered “be on the alert.”
NASB supplies “him” and renders “your brotherhood in the world” as “your brethren who are in the world.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in Christ,” “will Himself perfect, confirm, strengthen and establish you”).
NASB follows the critical text (“dominion forever and ever”).
NASB adds parentheses; “through few words” is rendered “briefly.”
NASB follows the critical text (“in Christ,” without “Jesus” and “Amen”).
